run_anonymization_data_prep: run the AnonymizationDataPrepStageService async to start A&A data prep containers for a private computation instance
start_containers_for_data_prep: start containers for the anonymization data preparation stage using the OneDocker service and server IPs
get_data_prep_status: get the current status of the anonymization data prep stage from the private computation instance
stop_data_prep_service: stop the anonymization data prep stage service and clean up associated containers
init_data_prep_stage_service: initialize an AnonymizationDataPrepStageService with a OneDocker service and binary configuration map
